sections.text:
-Increases the activation priority of this Unison effect by 1.
-Target: all allies. Recovers 60 Cost.
Cost recovery boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Rejection for 40 seconds with a success value of 110.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Frail for 40 seconds with a success value of 120.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Constriction. The next Ability used will change from targeting all to a single target (except for certain Abilities).
-Target: all allies. Applies Diffusion. The next Ability used will change from a specified single/range target to targeting all (except for certain Abilities).
-Target: all allies. Applies kijin (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction; boosts Ability Power of critical hits by 50; increases attack Ability accuracy by 30%; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking) for 120 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Rampart for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all elemental Unison damage Ability Power by 200; [Special] increases success value of all status ailment attacks, including Unison Effects and Ability Effects, by 50; nullifies special debuffs; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Light Qualia (increases all stats by 100%, increases light elemental attack by 10, increases light elemental defense by 150, and nullifies Insanity and Confuse) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Increases your character's max HP by 80% when equipped in the Main Slot.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 40000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Reduces physical/magic damage taken to 0 (7 times). Effect applied for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 40000
